facts.fact: Inés 给偷进厨房的 Nepomuceno 教授拿沙丁鱼、切香肠喂狗，并从上锁柜里倒雪莉酒给他——两人有秘密接济关系
facts.anchor: She grabbed a tin of sardines and placed it in his hands

facts.fact: 花园植物知识伏笔：haba de San Ignacio 籽少量退烧、大量有毒；barbasco 根煮水避孕
facts.anchor: the haba de San Ignacio, whose seeds in modest doses could cure a fever and in greater quantities were poisonous

facts.fact: 面包房 Marisol 转述姐姐的话：新客人长得像 Tyrone Power；全镇都知道 Perla 通过杂志寂寞芳心信箱与墨西哥城男人通信
facts.anchor: My sister said your new guest arrived today and he looks like Tyrone Power

facts.fact: Cándido Sotomayor（镇律师兼公证人，Perla 求婚者两年）拦住 Inés 收买她打探新房客
facts.anchor: “Let me help you, Inés,” he said.

facts.fact: Inés 索要报酬：姨妈零花仅每周十比索（实为谎话，她几乎没有零花），Cándido 掏钱买情报
Inés 的身世：母亲 Encarnación 在 Puebla 做裁缝、坠楼梯而死，是 Inés 第一个发现的；她此后几周失语
facts.anchor: It was Inés who had found her

facts.fact: Perla 克扣零花钱是控制手段：若 Inés 攒够钱就能离开 Puerco Ahogado，姨妈绝不容她走
facts.anchor: and her aunt had no intention of allowing her to do that

facts.fact: Salvador 的绝情信被 Inés 留在雪茄盒底提醒自己「男人皆狗」；她断言不会信任新客人
facts.anchor: but she was not going to trust him. Not one bit.
